Name: Regional Banking and Taxes System (RBTS) - Immersive and configurable mod (SPANISH)
Author: Blackreaper140
Description:
[center]This translation was made for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41480]Regional Banking and Taxes System (RBTS) mod[/url]﻿ - an immersive and configurable mod which adds a tax system and a banking system to version 1.6 of Stardew Valley

[color=#00ffff][size=3]How to INSTALL

[/size][/color][color=#00ffff]STEP 1:[/color] Download the translation.
[color=#00ffff]STEP 2:[/color] Unzip the file.
[color=#00ffff]STEP 3:[/color] Copy and paste the translation into the folder where the original mod is located (replace if prompted).


[color=#ffff00][size=5]Credits to the author of the original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/losgar38]losgar38[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/losgar38][/url]﻿[/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=5]
[/size][/color][/center]
